context.problem_statement: Create an async rate limiter class with a maximum of 5 requests per second

variables.name: request_count
variables.description: Number of requests made in the last second

variables.name: last_reset
variables.description: Time of last request count reset in seconds since epoch

edge_cases.scenario: more than 5 requests in a second

edge_cases.fallback_action: allow_request and set last_reset to current time
